title: Halverson Beverage Holdings: 2027 distribution strategy
text: Halverson plans to exit three regional bottling contracts in Q2 2027 and consolidate distribution through a single logistics partner. Board approval expected in January. Confidential pricing floor: 4% below current list.

title: Halverson Beverage Holdings: supplier dispute memo
text: Halverson's dispute with its glass supplier is likely to settle for under $2M. Litigation hold remains in place.

title: Lumenra Textiles: EU sustainability reporting
text: Lumenra must publish its first CSRD report for FY2026. Gaps: Scope 3 emissions data from two dye suppliers in Portugal. Recommended: supplier attestation templates by March.

title: Kestrel patent matter: Orrin Biologics prior art review
text: Three prior-art references weaken Orrin Biologics' claim 4. Strategy: move for partial summary judgment after the Markman hearing.

title: Glasswing Ventures: fund III side letters
text: Fund III has 14 side letters; 3 contain MFN clauses that conflict with the new co-investment policy. Recommend notifying LPs before the March close.
